== Title ==
<span lang="ja">サンドクローラー</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-150o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">８名までの乗客を運べる。タトゥイーンの位置カードに配備せねばならない。惑星の位置カードにしか移動できない。屋外の位置カードにいる場合、そこにいるジャワは没収値が＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">家畜小屋のような密閉型住居運搬用ビークル。タトゥイーンの略奪者から身を守る。元来は鉱物採掘車であり、鉱床閉鎖に伴い、ジャワ族が手に入れた。二つと同じ物はない。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Sandcrawler.

'''Card text:''' May carry up to eight passengers. Must deploy at a Tatooine site. May move only to planetary sites. At an exterior site, Jawas there are forfeit +1.

'''Lore:''' An enclosed vehicle for carrying living quarters, rather like a livestock shed. It protects against Tatooine raiders. Originally mining vehicles, they were acquired by Jawas when the mines closed. No two are alike.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 2
* '''Power:''' 3
* '''Armor:''' 3
* '''Landspeed:''' 2
* '''Deploy:''' 3
* '''Forfeit:''' 5

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
